incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: service=private-control-plane severity=critical reason=agent-heartbeat-missing customer=customer-1024
PagerDuty: INC12345 created · triggered for escalation policy 'Private Deployments - Critical' · urgency=high
Alex (oncall): acked oncall. I'm taking initial triage. tagging @Jamie and @Ryan. Maya: can you confirm customer impact?
Maya (CSE): customer-1024 reports 500s from their app when it tries to call our private control plane for model allocations. Started ~5m ago. They see repeated connection timeouts.
Jamie (eng-sre): I'm on it. running runbook `private-agent-heartbeat` now. First things: check agent heartbeat stream, control plane reachability, and any recent infra changes.
Ryan (infra): I'll check VPC peering and NAT/gateway logs in us-west-2 where this customer's private control plane is fronted.
Jamie (eng-sre): pulled last heartbeat for agent id agent-1024-az1: last seen 00:02:37 ago, status: DISCONNECTED. agent log tail below:
```
Mar 14 09:25:12 agent-1024 redwood-agent[1342]: WARN  connection: TLS handshake failed: read: connection reset by peer
Mar 14 09:25:12 agent-1024 redwood-agent[1342]: INFO  retrying connection in 3s
Mar 14 09:25:15 agent-1024 redwood-agent[1342]: INFO  connection established
Mar 14 09:27:49 agent-1024 redwood-agent[1342]: WARN  connection: write tcp 10.0.4.21:45123->34.210.10.12:443: write: broken pipe
Mar 14 09:27:49 agent-1024 redwood-agent[1342]: ERROR heartbeat: failed to send heartbeat: broken pipe
```
Jamie (eng-sre): pattern looks like intermittent TCP resets. could be NAT/timeout or firewall. next steps: remote into agent, tcpdump, systemctl restart redwood-agent if needed.
Alex (oncall): be careful with restarts - coordinate with CSE (Maya) so they can tell customer.
Ryan (infra): I see a recent route table update in staging→prod peering applied at 09:23:18 UTC that touched ephemeral port mapping rules for the NAT gateway on the customer's side. opening cloud console to inspect.
PagerDuty: INC12345 escalated to infra escalation level after 3m without ack from assigned user.
Jamie (eng-sre): ssh to agent-1024-az1 (jump via bastion): `ssh redwood@10.0.4.21`
Jamie (eng-sre): ran `journalctl -u redwood-agent -n 200 --no-pager` (snippet above) and `ss -ntp | grep 443` shows transient ESTABLISHED then RST.
Jamie (eng-sre): started tcpdump: `sudo tcpdump -i eth0 host 34.210.10.12 and port 443 -w /tmp/agent-443.pcap` streaming a few seconds. seeing TLS ClientHello and immediate RST from remote.
Ryan (infra): from the VPC side, NAT gateway logs show connection tracked but then a security group rule from the partner firewall is dropping return packets intermittently. Looks like partner changed stateful inspection timeout or introduced deep packet inspection appliance that resets long-lived flows.
Maya (CSE): customer-1024 says they rotated an edge firewall last night as part of maintenance. not in our change log. they're reverting patch now.
Alex (oncall): good catch. coordinate rollback. Jamie, can we avoid full restart and try to re-establish? if rollback succeeds, heartbeat should return.
Jamie (eng-sre): asking customer to revert firewall change. meanwhile I will put a config to increase keepalive and shorten connection reattempt to reduce visible errors. applying ephemeral config on agent:
```
# temporary agent overrides
redwood.agent.connection.tcp_keepalive=10
redwood.agent.connection.retry_interval=2s
```
Jamie (eng-sre): applied above via remote config API, agent restarted connection loop (no full systemd restart). watching heartbeat...
incident-bot: agent-1024 heartbeat state: CONNECTING -> CONNECTED at 09:30:05 UTC :white_check_mark:
PagerDuty: INC12345 acknowledged by Alex (oncall) and Jamie (eng-sre). escalation stopped.
Maya (CSE): customer confirmed rollback completed at 09:30:20 UTC and reported their app errors decreasing.
Jamie (eng-sre): verified sustained heartbeats for 3 consecutive intervals. `curl https://control.redwood.internal/agent/agent-1024/healthz` -> 200 OK.
Ryan (infra): added firewall rule checklist item and will open a support ticket with the partner network team to confirm their DPI device behavior.
Alex (oncall): I'm putting the incident into mitigation state. Impact: customer-1024 partial outage for ~7-8 minutes, control plane allocation failures; no token data leaked.
Jamie (eng-sre): follow-up actions (to-do): 1) permanent keepalive optimization for private-agents, 2) add alert that correlates agent heartbeat drops with recent partner firewall changes, 3) update runbook with tcpdump examples and partner-facing rollback instructions. I'll file tasks.
Maya (CSE): I'll coordinate a post-mortem call with customer and share timeline.
PagerDuty: INC12345 status: resolved (mitigated) at 09:35:34 UTC by Jamie (eng-sre).
Alex (oncall): handoff note: I'm off shift at 10:00 PST. Jamie will take lead for next 2 hours for follow-ups. tagging @Ryan for infra follow-ups.
Jamie (eng-sre): adding incident ticket REDW-3817 with links to logs, tcpdump, and customer communication. closing thread here. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident archived to incidents/REDW-3817.
